 "data": "sequenceDiagram
 actor Client
 participant AC as AuthController
 participant AM as AuthenticationManager
 participant UDS as AppUserDetailsService
 participant DAO as DaoAuthenticationProvider
 participant JS as JwtServiceImpl

 AC->>AM: authenticate(UsernamePasswordAuthenticationToken)
 AM->>DAO: authenticate()

 AM-->>AC: Authentication
 AC->>JS: generateToken(userDetails)
 JS-->>AC: signed JWT (HS256, expiry from config)
 AC-->>Client: AuthResponse{username, role[], token}",
 "config": null
